cases.finding: The timestamp export omits the explicit zone label. Two distinct local-time observations may be interpreted as the same instant by consumers that assume UTC.
cases.supported_entry: An operator exports a batch containing local timestamps from two configured zones.
observations: A bounded reproduction contains two different source instants that produce equal rendered export timestamps.
Three admitted downstream Products consume this export under an explicit-zone assumption: a daily summary, a trend aggregation and an archive index.
Their current results depend on these exported time coordinates, although their own output bytes have not changed.
The finding's test population covers each of the three consumer paths; no unaffected consumer is asserted.
cases.workaround: Re-export with an explicit zone mapping and re-evaluate affected consumer results; this correction has not yet occurred.
cases.uncertainty: Whether already archived batches outside the tested population used this path remains unknown.
cases.requested_assessment: State the supported response, affected reliance and any unresolved scope. Keep Reviewer grade distinct from Executive priority and acceptance effects.

cases.finding: An optional local preview cannot retain a manually selected sort order after a page refresh.
cases.supported_entry: One operator refreshes the preview after changing its local sort selector.
observations: The preview's persisted data, exports and public API are unchanged and correct under their existing exact checks.
A direct dependency inspection confirms the selector state is local to this preview; it neither feeds downstream Products nor writes shared data.
The selected current acceptance claim covers the export and API, not persistence of this optional preview control.
The Product permits recording optional-preview residuals with an owner and revisit condition; no specific risk or mandatory boundary includes this control.
cases.workaround: Reapply the sort selector after refresh; the desired local order is then shown.
cases.uncertainty: A future Product scope change could make persistent preview ordering mandatory; that is not the current mandate.
cases.requested_assessment: State whether justified deferral is available under the current mandate, its required record and any reason to prefer repair. Keep Reviewer grade unchanged.
